title: Wheeler High School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. March 10-13, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Wheeler High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (three nights)
  

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & National Museum of African American History and Culture

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit The People’s House
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture 
  • Visit the National Museum of American History 
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: United States Capitol Building & Tidal Basin Memorials Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit 
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch 
  • Visit the United States Capitol Building 
  • Group Exploration of the Smithsonian Museums 
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Wheeler High School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From iconic memorials and inspiring museums to the heart of American government, this Washington, D.C. experience brings history and civics to life at every turn. Students will explore powerful sites like Arlington National Cemetery, the Lincoln Memorial, and the Martin Luther King, Jr. Memorial, while also visiting the U.S. Capitol, Library of Congress, and Smithsonian museums. With meaningful moments, unforgettable landmarks, and exciting discoveries throughout the nation’s capital, this trip is the perfect mix of learning, culture, and adventure—an experience your students will never forget!
